_doc: Manual links of disk files for films.disks (R85). An entry applies to the file «path», or to the files directly in the folder «path» («recursive»: true — the whole tree), optionally only to file names matching the regex «match». Target: tmdb_tv (+ season; else the season from the file name) / tmdb_movie / imdb, or personal / not_film. «why» = the evidence.
